title: Adhesives
headline:
THE RIGHT BOND
STARTS WITH THE APPLICATION.
summary: Adhesive solutions for construction, manufacturing and industrial assembly.
heading: Bonding across different materials.
body: NAPCO’s adhesive portfolio includes hot-melt, instant and pressure-sensitive adhesives, thread-lockers and structural adhesives for construction and industrial applications.
Acrylic, epoxy and urethane technologies support bonding across substrates including bare and painted metal, composites and rubber-to-substrate assemblies.
Selection should begin with the substrates, joint design, production method and conditions in use. Product-specific suitability should be confirmed against current technical documentation.

Applications include waterproof bonding and sealing, foundation and basement damp-proofing, swimming-pool applications, roofing, bonding agents, grouts, sealants and coatings.

Concrete and cement, grout, structural adhesives, bonding agents, waterproofing, roofing, sealants and coatings can all form part of the construction requirement.

heading: Understand what the structure is exposed to.
body: NAPCO’s current construction overview describes waterproof bonding and sealing, foundation and basement damp-proofing, swimming-pool applications, roofing and other measures intended to limit moisture migration.
The protection requirement changes with the substrate, location and exposure. A below-grade interface, roof detail and wet-area application should not be treated as the same problem.
Define the exposure and construction detail first, then confirm the appropriate system against current NAPCO technical information.

title: History
headline:
BUILT OVER TIME.
STILL MOVING FORWARD.
summary: Key steps in NAPCO’s manufacturing and materials journey.
heading: From technical services to manufacturing.
body: NAPCO Industries (UK) has been involved in adhesives manufacturing since 1988, and a UAE manufacturing facility was established in 1995.
Solvent-borne adhesives were introduced in 1998, sealants in 2003 and an independent production facility in 2007.
These milestones reflect the evolution of NAPCO’s capabilities as adhesives, coatings and sealants developed alongside changing construction and industrial requirements.
